summary: Verified the UNLIMITED (max_strings=0) fix end-to-end. Backend: /api/rom/extract accepts max_strings=0, returns all strings with found_total==len(strings) for a 2MB Pokemon Gen3 ROM (1500 strings) and respects the 250 cap. Frontend: uploading the 2MB ROM and selecting 'UNLIMITED (all strings)' no longer crashes/freezes the tab. TranslationTable paginates at PAGE_SIZE=200, load-more-btn works (+200), filter works on both columns, cost-estimate shows $ amount, TRANSLATE button is enabled and UI stays responsive.
passed: POST /api/rom/extract max_strings=0 on 2MB Pokemon Gen3 ROM -> 200 OK, found_total=1500, len(strings)=1500, all required JSON keys present, Content-Type application/json (~1.7s)
POST /api/rom/extract ascii small.gb max_strings=500 -> extracts HELLO WORLD etc.
Frontend: UNLIMITED extract of 2MB ROM completes without tab crash
TranslationTable renders exactly 200 rows initially (data-testid row-0..row-199)
load-more-btn visible with '+200 more', clicking grows to 400 rows
table-search 'number 42' filters correctly to 11 rows across original+translated columns
translate-btn is enabled (not disabled) after successful UNLIMITED extract
Mode toggle to patch still responsive => UI not frozen
critical_code_review_comments: Filter regex PRINTABLE_RE in server.py at module level uses r-string with %d expansion — works but brittle; not a bug.
extract_rom re-runs a full ASCII scan (up to HARD_MAX_STRINGS=100000) just to compute found_total when max_strings>0. For very large ROMs this doubles CPU — could reuse extract count. Non-blocking.
TranslationTable 'Show all' hidden when filtered.length > 5000 which is a safe guard; good.
seed_data_creation: /tmp/big.gba (2MB Pokemon Gen3 synthetic ROM with 1500 encoded strings), /tmp/small.gb (4KB ASCII ROM with 9 strings) — built per problem statement snippet.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend and frontend both verified. LLM translate path was NOT re-tested (per instructions); prior iteration_1 reported Gemini upstream failures but that is orthogonal to this bug fix.
rca of the issue: Original crash was silent tab freeze because TranslationTable rendered ALL rows (~1500-5000+) at once, blocking React's reconciler main thread. Fix (already applied in /app/frontend/src/components/rom/TranslationTable.jsx) slices to PAGE_SIZE=200 with useMemo-derived filtered list and 'load more'/'Show all' buttons. Verified: DOM contains only 200 rows initially and grows on demand, no crash, UI remains interactive.
